description: Hands the search keys saved with /plugin configure to Claude Code's Bash commands through a private per-process file in the plugin data folder, deleted when the session ends. A key already in the Bash environment wins.

hooks.command: [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/_shared/plugin_keys.py" start; exit 0
[ -d "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/session-keys" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/_shared/plugin_keys.py" end; exit 0
